description: Edit stage of the pipeline: make each planned change with edit.py; check.py runs automatically after every applied edit.
steps: SHOW: show.py on the code of the change
EDIT: edit.py [file, start, end, new lines] with the line numbers shown
VERIFY: check.py runs automatically after every applied edit; if it undoes a breaking edit, edit again
REPORT: EDITED and VERDICT as the final message
